translations.idiomatic: Grand General Duke of Ningdu Yu, Duke of Gaoyang Daxi Wu, Duke of Wuyang Dou Lu'ning, Lesser Director of the Court Duke of Yangping Li Yuan, Lesser Grand Marshal Duke of Boling Helan Chan, Lesser Master of Ceremonies Duke of Wei'an Wei Chiji, and others were all made Pillars of State.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，祀圓丘。

translations.literal: On the day renyin the Round Mound was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin the Round Mound was sacrificed to.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「予本自神農，其於二丘，宜作厥主。

translations.literal: An edict said: "I trace my origin to Shennong; for the two mounds I should serve as their lord.
translations.idiomatic: An edict said, "I trace my origin to Shennong; for the two mounds I should serve as their lord.

sentences.zh: 始祖獻侯，啟土遼海，配南北郊；

translations.literal: The founding ancestor Marquis of Xian opened the land in Liaohai and is paired at the southern and northern suburbs;
translations.idiomatic: The founding ancestor Marquis of Xian opened the land in Liaohai and is paired at the southern and northern suburbs;

sentences.zh: 文考德符五運，受天明命，祖於明堂，以配上帝。

translations.literal: my late father's virtue matched the five phases; he received Heaven's bright mandate and is honored in the Bright Hall, paired with the Supreme Lord.
translations.idiomatic: my late father's virtue matched the five phases; he received Heaven's bright mandate and is honored in the Bright Hall, paired with the Supreme Lord.

sentences.zh: 」癸卯，祀方丘。

translations.literal: On the day guimao the Square Mound was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao the Square Mound was sacrificed to.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，遂祭太社。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen the Great Altar of Soil was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen the Great Altar of Soil was sacrificed to.

sentences.zh: 初除市門稅。

translations.literal: Market gate taxes were abolished for the first time.
translations.idiomatic: Market gate taxes were abolished for the first time.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，享太廟。

translations.literal: On the day yisi the Grand Temple was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi the Grand Temple was sacrificed to.

sentences.zh: 丁未，會於幹安殿，班賞各有差。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei an assembly was held at Gan'an Hall and rewards were distributed in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei an assembly was held at Gan'an Hall and rewards were distributed in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 戊申，詔有司分命使者，巡察風俗，求人得失，禮餼高年，恤於鰥寡。

translations.literal: On the day wushen an edict ordered the relevant offices to dispatch envoys to inspect local custom, seek out men's gains and losses, offer gifts to the aged, and show compassion to widows and orphans.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen an edict ordered the relevant offices to dispatch envoys to inspect local custom, seek out men's gains and losses, offer gifts to the aged, and show compassion to widows and orphans.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，祀南郊。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai the southern suburb was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the southern suburb was sacrificed to.

sentences.zh: 壬子，立王後元氏。

translations.literal: On the day renzi the Queen Wang of the Yuan clan was established.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Queen Wang of the Yuan clan was established.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，享太廟。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou the Grand Temple was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou the Grand Temple was sacrificed to.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，親耕籍田。

translations.literal: On the day guihai the Emperor personally plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the Emperor personally plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 二月癸酉朔，朝日於東郊。

translations.literal: On the first day guiyou of the second month the sun was worshipped at the eastern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, the first day of the second month, the sun was worshipped at the eastern suburb.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，祭太社。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin the Great Altar of Soil was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin the Great Altar of Soil was sacrificed to.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，柱國、楚國公趙貴謀反，伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai Pillar of State, Duke of Chu Zhao Gui plotted rebellion and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Pillar of State, Duke of Chu Zhao Gui plotted rebellion and was executed.

sentences.zh: 太保獨孤信罪免。

translations.literal: Grand Guardian Dugu Xin was punished by removal from office.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Guardian Dugu Xin was punished by removal from office.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以大司空、梁國公侯莫陳崇為太保；

translations.literal: On the day jiawu Grand Minister of Works, Duke of Liang Houmochen Chong was made Grand Guardian;
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Grand Minister of Works, Duke of Liang Houmochen Chong was made Grand Guardian;

sentences.zh: 大司馬、晉國公護為大冢宰；

translations.literal: Grand Marshal, Duke of Jin Hu, was made Grand Minister;
translations.idiomatic: Grand Marshal, Duke of Jin Hu, was made Grand Minister;

sentences.zh: 柱國、博陵公賀蘭禪為大司馬；

translations.literal: Pillar of State, Duke of Boling Helan Chan, was made Grand Marshal;
translations.idiomatic: Pillar of State, Duke of Boling Helan Chan, was made Grand Marshal;

sentences.zh: 高陽公達奚武為大司寇；

translations.literal: Duke of Gaoyang Daxi Wu was made Grand Minister of Justice;
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Gaoyang Daxi Wu was made Grand Minister of Justice;

sentences.zh: 大將軍、化政公宇文貴為柱國。

translations.literal: Grand General, Duke of Huazheng Yuwen Gui, was made Pillar of State.
translations.idiomatic: Grand General, Duke of Huazheng Yuwen Gui, was made Pillar of State.

sentences.zh: 三月己酉，衛國公獨孤信賜死。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou Duke of Weiguo Dugu Xin was ordered to take his own life.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Duke of Weiguo Dugu Xin was ordered to take his own life.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，省六府士員三分之一。

translations.literal: On the day guihai the staff of the Six Offices was reduced by one third.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the staff of the Six Offices was reduced by one third.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬申，降死罪已下囚。

translations.literal: On the day renshen of the fourth month in summer, prisoners sentenced to death and below were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen of the fourth month in summer, prisoners sentenced to death and below were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 壬午，謁成陵。

translations.literal: On the day renwu he visited Chengling.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu he visited Chengling.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，享太廟。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai the Grand Temple was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai the Grand Temple was sacrificed to.

sentences.zh: 五月己酉，帝將觀漁於昆明池，博士姜頃諫，乃止。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou of the fifth month the Emperor was about to watch fishing at Kunming Pool; Academician Jiang Qing remonstrated, and he stopped.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou of the fifth month the Emperor was about to watch fishing at Kunming Pool; Academician Jiang Qing remonstrated, and he stopped.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬寅，帝聽訟於右寢，多所哀宥。

translations.literal: On the day renyin of the seventh month in autumn the Emperor heard cases in the western chamber and showed much mercy.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin of the seventh month in autumn the Emperor heard cases in the western chamber and showed much mercy.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，享太廟。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai the Grand Temple was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the Grand Temple was sacrificed to.

sentences.zh: 八月戊辰，祭太社。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen of the eighth month the Great Altar of Soil was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen of the eighth month the Great Altar of Soil was sacrificed to.

sentences.zh: 辛未，降死罪已下囚。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei prisoners sentenced to death and below were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei prisoners sentenced to death and below were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔二十四軍舉賢良。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu an edict ordered the twenty-four armies to recommend worthy men.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu an edict ordered the twenty-four armies to recommend worthy men.

sentences.zh: 九月庚申，改太守為郡守。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen of the ninth month grand administrators were changed to commandery governors.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen of the ninth month grand administrators were changed to commandery governors.

sentences.zh: 帝性剛果，忌晉公護之專。

translations.literal: The Emperor was by nature firm and decisive and resented the Duke of Jin Hu's monopoly of power.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was by nature firm and decisive and resented Duke of Jin Hu's monopoly of power.

sentences.zh: 司會李植、軍司馬孫恒以先朝佐命，入侍左右，亦疾護權重，乃與宮伯乙鳳、賀拔提等潛請帝誅護，帝許之。

translations.literal: Director of Accounts Li Zhi and Army Marshal Sun Heng, who had assisted the previous reign and attended at his side, also hated Hu's heavy authority; together with Palace Commander Yi Feng, Heba Ti, and others they secretly asked the Emperor to execute Hu, and the Emperor agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Director of Accounts Li Zhi and Army Marshal Sun Heng, who had assisted the previous reign and attended at his side, also hated Hu's heavy authority; together with Palace Commander Yi Feng, Heba Ti, and others they secretly asked the Emperor to execute Hu, and the Emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 又引宮伯張先洛。

translations.literal: They also brought in Palace Commander Zhang Xianluo.
translations.idiomatic: They also brought in Palace Commander Zhang Xianluo.

sentences.zh: 先洛以白護，護乃出植為梁州刺史，恒為潼州刺史。

translations.literal: Xianluo reported it to Hu; Hu therefore sent Zhi out as Governor of Liangzhou and Heng as Governor of Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Xianluo reported it to Hu; Hu therefore sent Zhi out as Governor of Liangzhou and Heng as Governor of Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 鳳等更奏帝，將召群臣入，因此誅護。

translations.literal: Feng and the others again memorialized the Emperor, planning to summon the ministers to enter and thereby execute Hu.
translations.idiomatic: Feng and the others again memorialized the Emperor, planning to summon the ministers to enter and thereby execute Hu.

sentences.zh: 先洛又白之。

translations.literal: Xianluo again reported it.
translations.idiomatic: Xianluo again reported it.

sentences.zh: 時小司馬尉綱總統宿衛兵。

translations.literal: At that time Lesser Grand Marshal Wei Gang commanded the palace guard.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Lesser Grand Marshal Wei Gang commanded the palace guard.

sentences.zh: 護乃召綱入殿中，詐呼鳳等論事，以次執送護弟，並誅之。

translations.literal: Hu then summoned Gang into the hall, falsely called Feng and the others to discuss affairs, and had them seized one by one and sent to Hu's brother; all were executed.
translations.idiomatic: Hu then summoned Gang into the hall, falsely called Feng and the others to discuss affairs, and had them seized one by one and sent to Hu's brother; all were executed.

sentences.zh: 綱乃罷禁兵，帝無左右，獨在內殿，令宮人執兵自守。

translations.literal: Gang then dismissed the guard; the Emperor had no attendants and was alone in the inner hall, ordering palace women to take up arms in self-defense.
translations.idiomatic: Gang then dismissed the guard; the Emperor had no attendants and was alone in the inner hall, ordering palace women to take up arms in self-defense.

sentences.zh: 護遣大司馬賀蘭祥逼帝遜位，貶為略陽公，遂幽於舊邸。

translations.literal: Hu sent Grand Marshal Helan Xiang to force the Emperor to abdicate; he was demoted to Duke of Lueyang and then confined in his old residence.
translations.idiomatic: Hu sent Grand Marshal Helan Xiang to force abdication; the Emperor was demoted to Duke of Lueyang and confined in his old residence.

sentences.zh: 月餘日，以弒崩，時年十六。

translations.literal: After more than a month he died by assassination; he was sixteen years old.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a month he was assassinated; he was sixteen.

sentences.zh: 植、恒等亦遇害。

translations.literal: Zhi, Heng, and the others also met with death.
translations.idiomatic: Zhi, Heng, and the others were killed as well.

sentences.zh: 及武帝誅護後，乃詔曰：「故略陽公至德純粹，天姿秀傑。

translations.literal: After Emperor Wu executed Hu, an edict said: "The late Duke of Lueyang possessed supreme virtue in purity and a naturally outstanding talent.
translations.idiomatic: After Emperor Wu executed Hu, an edict said, "The late Duke of Lueyang possessed supreme virtue and a naturally outstanding talent.

sentences.zh: 屬魏詐告終，寶命將改，謳歌允集，歷數攸歸。

translations.literal: When Wei's deceit reached its end and the precious mandate was about to change, songs of praise gathered and the count of Heaven rested with him.
translations.idiomatic: When Wei's deceit reached its end and the mandate was about to change, songs of praise gathered and Heaven's count rested with him.

sentences.zh: 上協蒼靈之慶，下昭後祗之錫。

translations.literal: Above he accorded with the blessing of the dark numen; below he displayed the gift of the later altar.
translations.idiomatic: Above he accorded with the blessing of the dark numen; below he displayed the gift of the later altar.

sentences.zh: 而禍生肘腋，釁起蕭墻；

translations.literal: Yet calamity arose at the elbow and trouble sprang from within the courtyard wall;
translations.idiomatic: Yet calamity arose at the elbow and trouble sprang from within the courtyard wall;

sentences.zh: 白武噬驂，蒼鷹集殿；

translations.literal: the white tiger devoured the paired horses, and the dark hawk gathered on the palace hall;
translations.idiomatic: the white tiger devoured the paired horses, and the dark hawk gathered on the palace hall;

sentences.zh: 幽辱神器，弒酷乘輿；

translations.literal: the sacred regalia was humiliated, and the imperial carriage met cruel murder;
translations.idiomatic: the sacred regalia was humiliated, and the imperial carriage met cruel murder;

sentences.zh: 冤結生靈，毒流宇縣。

translations.literal: grievance bound the living, and poison flowed through the realm.
translations.idiomatic: grievance bound the living, and poison flowed through the realm.

sentences.zh: 今河海登清，氛沴消蕩；

translations.literal: Now the rivers and seas are clear and the miasma of calamity has dissolved;
translations.idiomatic: Now the rivers and seas are clear and the miasma of calamity has dissolved;

sentences.zh: 追尊之禮，宜崇徽號。

translations.literal: the rites of posthumous honor should be raised with a lofty title.
translations.idiomatic: the rites of posthumous honor should be raised with a lofty title.

sentences.zh: 」遣太師、蜀國公迥於南郊，上謚曰孝閔皇帝，陵曰靜陵。

translations.literal: " Grand Preceptor, Duke of Shu Wei Chiji, was sent to the southern suburb to confer the posthumous title Emperor Xiaomin; his tomb was named Jingling.
translations.idiomatic: " Grand Preceptor, Duke of Shu Wei Chiji, was sent to the southern suburb to confer the posthumous title Emperor Xiaomin; his tomb was named Jingling.

sentences.zh: 世宗明皇帝諱毓，小名統萬突。

translations.literal: Emperor Shizong Ming, taboo name Yu, childhood name Tongwantu.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Shizong Ming, taboo name Yu, childhood name Tongwantu.

sentences.zh: 文皇帝之長子也。

translations.literal: He was the eldest son of Emperor Wen.
translations.idiomatic: He was Emperor Wen's eldest son.

sentences.zh: 母曰姚夫人。

translations.literal: His mother was Lady Yao.
translations.idiomatic: His mother was Lady Yao.

sentences.zh: 永熙三年，文帝臨夏州，生於統萬城，因以名焉。

translations.literal: In the third year of Yongxi, when Emperor Wen was at Xiazhou, he was born at Tongwan City; he was therefore so named.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongxi year three, when Emperor Wen was at Xiazhou, he was born at Tongwan City and was therefore so named.

sentences.zh: 大統十四年，封寧都郡公。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Datong he was enfeoffed as Duke of Ningdu Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In Datong year fourteen he was enfeoffed as Duke of Ningdu Commandery.

sentences.zh: 魏恭帝三年，累遷大將軍，鎮隴右。

translations.literal: In the third year of Emperor Gong of Wei he was promoted in succession to Grand General and garrisoned Longyou.
translations.idiomatic: In Wei Emperor Gong year three he rose in succession to Grand General and garrisoned Longyou.

sentences.zh: 孝閔踐阼，進位柱國，轉岐州刺史，有美政。

translations.literal: When Xiaomin ascended the throne, he was promoted to Pillar of State and transferred to Governor of Qi Province, where his governance was praised.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiaomin ascended the throne, he was promoted to Pillar of State and made Governor of Qi Province, where his governance was praised.

sentences.zh: 及孝閔廢，晉公護遣迎帝於岐州。

translations.literal: When Xiaomin was deposed, Duke of Jin Hu sent envoys to welcome the Emperor from Qi Province.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiaomin was deposed, Duke of Jin Hu sent envoys to welcome the Emperor from Qi Province.

sentences.zh: 九月癸亥，至京師，止於舊邸。

translations.literal: On the day guihai of the ninth month he reached the capital and halted at his old residence.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai of the ninth month he reached the capital and halted at his old residence.

sentences.zh: 群臣上表勸進，備法駕奉迎，帝固讓，群臣固請，乃許之。

translations.literal: The ministers memorialized urging him to ascend; the full imperial equipage was prepared to welcome him; the Emperor firmly declined, but when the ministers pressed again he consented.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers memorialized urging ascent; the full imperial equipage was prepared; the Emperor declined, but when they pressed again he consented.

sentences.zh: 元年秋九月，天王即位，大赦。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the first year in autumn the Heavenly King ascended the throne and proclaimed a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of year one in autumn the Heavenly King ascended the throne and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，朝郡臣於延壽殿。

translations.literal: On the day yichou he attended upon the commandery ministers at Yanshou Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou he attended upon the commandery ministers at Yanshou Hall.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸酉，太師、趙國公李弼薨。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou of the tenth month in winter Grand Preceptor, Prince of Zhao Commandery Li Bi died.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou of the tenth month in winter Grand Preceptor, Prince of Zhao Commandery Li Bi died.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以大將軍、昌平公尉綱為柱國。

translations.literal: On the day jimao Grand General, Duke of Changping Wei Gang was made Pillar of State.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Grand General, Duke of Changping Wei Gang was made Pillar of State.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，祀圓丘。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou the Round Mound was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou the Round Mound was sacrificed to.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，祀方丘。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu the Square Mound was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu the Square Mound was sacrificed to.

sentences.zh: 甲午，祭太社。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu the Great Altar of Soil was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu the Great Altar of Soil was sacrificed to.

sentences.zh: 陽平公李遠賜死。

translations.literal: Duke of Yangping Li Yuan was ordered to take his own life.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Yangping Li Yuan was ordered to take his own life.

sentences.zh: 辛未，梁敬帝遜位於陳。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei Emperor Jing of Liang abdicated to Chen.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei Emperor Jing of Liang abdicated to Chen.

sentences.zh: 十一月庚子，享太廟。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi of the eleventh month the Grand Temple was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi of the eleventh month the Grand Temple was sacrificed to.

sentences.zh: 丁未，祀圓丘。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei the Round Mound was sacrificed to.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei the Round Mound was sacrificed to.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚午，謁成陵。

translations.literal: On the day gengwu of the twelfth month he visited Chengling.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu of the twelfth month he visited Chengling.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以大將軍、輔城公邕為柱國。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen Grand General, Duke of Fucheng Yong was made Pillar of State.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Grand General, Duke of Fucheng Yong was made Pillar of State.

sentences.zh: 戊子，赦長安見囚。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi prisoners in Chang'an were pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi prisoners in Chang'an were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 甲午，詔元氏子女自坐趙貴等事以來，所有沒入為官口者，悉免之。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu an edict said that sons and daughters of the Yuan clan who, since the affair of Zhao Gui and others, had been confiscated as government slaves were all to be released.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu an edict released all sons and daughters of the Yuan clan confiscated as government slaves since the affair of Zhao Gui and others.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月乙未，以大冢宰、晉公護為太師。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei of the second month in spring Grand Minister, Duke of Jin Hu, was made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei of the second month in spring Grand Minister, Duke of Jin Hu, was made Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，親耕籍田。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai the Emperor personally plowed the sacred field.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the Emperor personally plowed the sacred field.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，立王後獨孤氏。

translations.literal: On the day guichou Queen Dugu was established.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Queen Dugu was established.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，於雍州置十二郡。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi twelve commanderies were established in Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi twelve commanderies were established in Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 三月甲午，北豫州刺史司馬消難舉州來附。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu of the third month Governor of Beiyu Sima Xiaonan surrendered the province.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu of the third month Governor of Beiyu Sima Xiaonan surrendered the province.

sentences.zh: 改雍州刺史為牧，京兆郡守為尹。

translations.literal: The Governor of Yongzhou was changed to Prefect, and the Commandery Governor of Jingzhao to Intendant.
translations.idiomatic: The Governor of Yongzhou was changed to Prefect, and the Commandery Governor of Jingzhao to Intendant.

sentences.zh: 庚申，詔三十六國、九十九姓，自魏南徙，皆稱河南人；

translations.literal: On the day gengshen an edict said that the thirty-six states and ninety-nine clans, since being moved south by Wei, had all been called people of Henan;
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen an edict said that the thirty-six states and ninety-nine clans, moved south by Wei, had all been called people of Henan;

sentences.zh: 今周室既都關中，宜改稱京兆人。

translations.literal: now that the house of Zhou had its capital in Guanzhong, they should be changed to people of Jingzhao.
translations.idiomatic: now that Zhou had its capital in Guanzhong, they should be changed to people of Jingzhao.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己巳，以太師、晉公護為雍州牧。

translations.literal: On the day jisi of the fourth month in summer Grand Preceptor, Duke of Jin Hu, was made Prefect of Yongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi of the fourth month in summer Grand Preceptor, Duke of Jin Hu, was made Prefect of Yongzhou.

sentences.zh: 辛未，降死罪囚一等，五歲刑已下皆原之。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei prisoners sentenced to death had their punishment reduced one degree, and those with sentences of five years or below were all pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei prisoners sentenced to death had their punishment reduced one degree, and those with sentences of five years or below were all pardoned.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，天王後獨孤氏崩。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen the Heavenly King's consort Lady Dugu died.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen the Heavenly King's consort Lady Dugu died.

sentences.zh: 甲申，葬敬後。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen Empress Jing was buried.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen Empress Jing was buried.

sentences.zh: 五月乙未，以大司空、梁國公侯莫陳崇為大宗伯。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei of the fifth month Grand Minister of Works, Duke of Liang Houmochen Chong, was made Grand Master of Ceremonies.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei of the fifth month Grand Minister of Works, Duke of Liang Houmochen Chong, was made Grand Master of Ceremonies.

sentences.zh: 六月癸亥，嚈噠國遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On the day guihai of the sixth month the state of Yeda sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai of the sixth month the state of Yeda sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 己巳，板授高年刺史、守、令，恤鰥寡孤獨各有差。

translations.literal: On the day jisi elderly men were appointed by plaque as governors, prefects, and magistrates; widows, orphans, and the solitary were shown compassion in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi elderly men were appointed by plaque as governors, prefects, and magistrates; widows, orphans, and the solitary were shown compassion in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 分長安為萬年縣，並居京城。

translations.literal: Chang'an was divided into Wannian County, both dwelling in the capital city.
translations.idiomatic: Chang'an was divided into Wannian County, both dwelling in the capital city.

sentences.zh: 壬申，遣使分行州郡，理囚徒，察風俗，掩骸埋胔。

translations.literal: On the day renshen envoys were dispatched to travel through the provinces and commanderies, try prisoners, inspect custom, and cover exposed bones and bury flesh.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen envoys were dispatched through the provinces and commanderies to try prisoners, inspect custom, and cover exposed bones and bury flesh.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，順陽獻三足烏。

translations.literal: In the seventh month in autumn Shunyang presented a three-footed crow.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month in autumn Shunyang presented a three-footed crow.

sentences.zh: 八月甲子，群臣上表稱慶。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi of the eighth month the ministers memorialized offering congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi of the eighth month the ministers memorialized offering congratulations.

sentences.zh: 於是大赦，文武普進級。

translations.literal: Thereupon a great amnesty was proclaimed and civil and military officers were all promoted one rank.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon a great amnesty was proclaimed and civil and military officers were all promoted one rank.

sentences.zh: 九月辛卯，以大將軍楊忠、王雄並為柱國。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao Grand Generals Yang Zhong and Wang Xiong were both made Pillars of State.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Grand Generals Yang Zhong and Wang Xiong were both made Pillars of State.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，封少師元羅為韓國公，以紹魏後。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen Junior Preceptor Yuan Luo was enfeoffed as Duke of Han to continue the line of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Junior Preceptor Yuan Luo was enfeoffed as Duke of Han to continue the line of Wei.

sentences.zh: 丁未，行幸同州故宅，賦詩。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei he traveled to his old home at Tongzhou and composed a poem.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei he traveled to his old home at Tongzhou and composed a poem.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛酉，突厥遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou of the tenth month in winter the Turks sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou of the tenth month in winter the Turks sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，太廟成。

translations.literal: On the day guihai the Grand Temple was completed.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai the Grand Temple was completed.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以功臣瑯邪貞獻公賀拔勝等十三人配享文帝廟庭。

translations.literal: On the day yihai the meritorious ministers, including Duke of Langye Zhenxian Heba Sheng and twelve others, were paired in sacrifice at Emperor Wen's temple hall.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai the meritorious ministers, including Duke of Langye Zhenxian Heba Sheng and twelve others, were paired in sacrifice at Emperor Wen's temple hall.

sentences.zh: 壬午，大赦。

translations.literal: On the day renwu a great amnesty was proclaimed.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu a great amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 武成元年春正月己酉，太師、晉公護上表歸政。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou of the first month in spring of the first year of Wucheng, Grand Preceptor, Duke of Jin Hu, memorialized returning government to the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou of the first month in spring of Wucheng year one, Grand Preceptor, Duke of Jin Hu, memorialized returning government to the Emperor.

sentences.zh: 帝始親萬機，軍旅猶總於護。

translations.literal: The Emperor then personally handled the myriad affairs of state; military affairs still remained under Hu's overall command.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor then personally handled state affairs; military affairs still remained under Hu's overall command.

sentences.zh: 初改都督諸州軍事為總管。

translations.literal: For the first time Commander of Military Affairs of the Various Provinces was changed to Area Commander.
translations.idiomatic: For the first time Commander of Military Affairs of the Various Provinces was changed to Area Commander.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳，陳六軍，帝親擐甲胄，迎太白於東方。

translations.literal: On the day guisi of the third month the Six Armies were displayed; the Emperor personally donned armor and welcomed the White Planet in the east.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi of the third month the Six Armies were displayed; the Emperor personally donned armor and welcomed the White Planet in the east.

sentences.zh: 吐谷渾寇邊。

translations.literal: Tuyuhun raided the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: Tuyuhun raided the frontier.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，遣大司馬、博陵公賀蘭祥率眾討之。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu Grand Minister of Justice, Duke of Boling Helan Xiang, was sent to lead troops against them.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Grand Minister of Justice, Duke of Boling Helan Xiang, was sent to lead troops against them.

sentences.zh: 夏五月戊子，詔有司造周歷。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi of the fifth month in summer an edict ordered the relevant offices to compile the Zhou calendar.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi of the fifth month in summer an edict ordered the relevant offices to compile the Zhou calendar.

sentences.zh: 己亥，聽訟於正武殿。

translations.literal: On the day jihai he heard cases at Zhengwu Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai he heard cases at Zhengwu Hall.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，以大宗伯、梁國公侯莫陳崇為大司徒；

translations.literal: On the day xinhai Grand Master of Ceremonies, Duke of Liang Houmochen Chong, was made Grand Minister of Education;
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai Grand Master of Ceremonies, Duke of Liang Houmochen Chong, was made Grand Minister of Education;

sentences.zh: 大司寇、高陽公達奚武為大宗伯；

translations.literal: Grand Minister of Justice, Duke of Gaoyang Daxi Wu, was made Grand Master of Ceremonies;
translations.idiomatic: Grand Minister of Justice, Duke of Gaoyang Daxi Wu, was made Grand Master of Ceremonies;

sentences.zh: 武陽公豆盧寧為大司寇；

translations.literal: Duke of Wuyang Dou Lu'ning was made Grand Minister of Justice;
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Wuyang Dou Lu'ning was made Grand Minister of Justice;

sentences.zh: 柱國、輔城公邕為大司空。

translations.literal: Pillar of State, Duke of Fucheng Yong, was made Grand Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Pillar of State, Duke of Fucheng Yong, was made Grand Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，詔曰：「比屢有糾發官司赦前事者，有司自今勿推究。

translations.literal: On the day yimao an edict said: "Recently there have repeatedly been cases of officials reporting pre-amnesty matters; the relevant offices from now on shall not investigate them.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao an edict said, "Recently officials have repeatedly reported pre-amnesty matters; the relevant offices shall not investigate them from now on.

sentences.zh: 唯庫既倉廩，與海內所共。

translations.literal: Only the storehouses and granaries are held in common with all within the seas.
translations.idiomatic: Only the storehouses and granaries are held in common with all within the seas.

sentences.zh: 漢帝有云：『朕為天下守財耳。

translations.literal: Emperor Han said: 'I am but keeper of the realm's wealth.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Han said, 'I am but keeper of the realm's wealth.

sentences.zh: 』若有侵盜公家財畜錢粟者，魏朝之事，年月既遠，一不須問；

translations.literal: " If anyone steals or embezzles public livestock, grain, or money, matters of the Wei court, remote in years, need not be questioned at all;
translations.idiomatic: " If anyone steals or embezzles public livestock, grain, or money, matters of the Wei court, remote in years, need not be questioned at all;

sentences.zh: 自周有天下以來，雖經赦宥，事跡可知者，有司宜即推窮。

translations.literal: since Zhou received the realm, even if pardoned, where the facts can still be known, the relevant offices should at once pursue the investigation.
translations.idiomatic: since Zhou received the realm, even if pardoned, where the facts can still be known, the relevant offices should pursue the investigation at once.

sentences.zh: 得實之日，免其罪，征備如法。

translations.literal: On the day the facts are established, the crime is pardoned and restitution is levied according to law.
translations.idiomatic: On the day the facts are established, the crime is pardoned and restitution is levied according to law.

sentences.zh: 」賀蘭祥攻拔洮陽、洪和二城，吐谷渾遁走。

translations.literal: " Helan Xiang attacked and took the cities of Taoyang and Honghe, and Tuyuhun fled.
translations.idiomatic: " Helan Xiang attacked and took Taoyang and Honghe, and Tuyuhun fled.

sentences.zh: 閏月，高昌遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month Gaochang sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month Gaochang sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 六月戊子，大雨霖。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi of the sixth month heavy rain fell for many days.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi of the sixth month heavy rain fell for many days.

sentences.zh: 詔公卿大夫士爰及牧守黎庶等，令各上封事，讜言極諫，無有所諱。

translations.literal: An edict ordered dukes, ministers, grand masters, scholars, governors, prefects, magistrates, and common people to each submit sealed memorials, offering candid remonstrance without reserve.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered dukes, ministers, grand masters, scholars, governors, prefects, magistrates, and common people to submit sealed memorials offering candid remonstrance without reserve.

sentences.zh: 其遭水者，有司可時巡檢，條列以聞。

translations.literal: Those who suffered from the flood should be inspected in timely rounds by the relevant offices and reported item by item.
translations.idiomatic: Those who suffered from the flood should be inspected in timely rounds by the relevant offices and reported item by item.

sentences.zh: 庚子，詔曰：「潁川從我，是曰元勛；

translations.literal: On the day gengzi an edict said: "Yingchuan followed me; that is called the founding merit;
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi an edict said, "Yingchuan followed me; that is the founding merit;

sentences.zh: 無忘父城，實起王業。

translations.literal: do not forget the father's city; it truly began the royal enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: do not forget the father's city; it truly began the royal enterprise.

sentences.zh: 文考屬天地草昧，造化權輿，拯彼流亡，匡茲頹運。

translations.literal: My late father, amid the dark chaos of Heaven and Earth and the first stirrings of creation, rescued the exiled and upheld the failing mandate.
translations.idiomatic: My late father, amid the dark chaos of Heaven and Earth and the first stirrings of creation, rescued the exiled and upheld the failing mandate.

sentences.zh: 賴英賢盡力，文武同心，翼贊大功，克隆帝業。

translations.literal: Relying on worthy men who exhausted their strength and civil and military men of one mind, they aided the great achievement and multiplied the imperial enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: Relying on worthy men who exhausted their strength and civil and military men of one mind, they aided the great achievement and multiplied the imperial enterprise.

sentences.zh: 而被堅執銳，櫛風沐雨，永言疇昔，良用憮然。

translations.literal: Yet bearing hard armor and sharp weapons, combing the wind and bathing in rain, when I speak of those former days I am deeply moved.
translations.idiomatic: Yet bearing hard armor and sharp weapons, combing the wind and bathing in rain, when I speak of those former days I am deeply moved.

sentences.zh: 若功成名遂，建國割符，予唯休也。

translations.literal: If merit is achieved and the enterprise completed, and a state is founded with territory divided, that is my rest.
translations.idiomatic: If merit is achieved and the enterprise completed, and a state is founded with territory divided, that is my rest.

sentences.zh: 其有致死王事，妻子無歸者，朕甚傷之。

translations.literal: Those who died serving the royal cause and left wives and children with no home grieve me deeply.
translations.idiomatic: Those who died serving the royal cause and left wives and children with no home grieve me deeply.

sentences.zh: 凡從先王向夏州，發夏州從來，見在及薨亡者，並量賜錢帛，稱朕意焉。」

translations.literal: All who followed the former king to Xiazhou, and all who set out from Xiazhou then and are now living or have died, shall be granted money and silk in measure according to my intent."
translations.idiomatic: All who followed the former king to Xiazhou, and all who set out from Xiazhou then and are now living or have died, shall be granted money and silk in measure according to my intent."

sentences.zh: 是月，陳武帝殂。

translations.literal: That month Emperor Wu of Chen died.
translations.idiomatic: That month Emperor Wu of Chen died.

sentences.zh: 秋八月己亥，改天王稱皇帝，追尊文王為文皇帝。

translations.literal: On the day jihai of the eighth month in autumn the title Heavenly King was changed to Emperor, and Prince Wen was posthumously honored as Emperor Wen.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai of the eighth month in autumn the title Heavenly King was changed to Emperor, and Prince Wen was posthumously honored as Emperor Wen.

sentences.zh: 大赦，改元。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed and the reign title was changed.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed and the reign title was changed.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，增禦正四人，位上大夫。

translations.literal: On the day guichou four Directors of the Imperial Household were added, with rank of Senior Grand Master.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou four Directors of the Imperial Household were added, with rank of Senior Grand Master.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，齊文宣帝殂。

translations.literal: In the tenth month in winter Emperor Wenxuan of Qi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month in winter Emperor Wenxuan of Qi died.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月癸丑朔，大會群臣於紫極殿，始用百戲。

translations.literal: In the first month of the second year, on the first day guichou, a great assembly of ministers was held at Ziji Hall, and the hundred entertainments were used for the first time.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of year two, on guichou, the first day, a great assembly of ministers was held at Ziji Hall, and the hundred entertainments were used for the first time.

sentences.zh: 三月辛酉，重陽閣成，會群臣公侯列將卿大夫及突厥使於芳林園，賜錢帛各有差。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou of the third month Chongyang Pavilion was completed; ministers, dukes, ranked generals, and grand masters, together with Turk envoys, were assembled at Fanglin Garden and given money and silk in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou of the third month Chongyang Pavilion was completed; ministers, dukes, ranked generals, and grand masters, together with Turk envoys, were assembled at Fanglin Garden and given money and silk in varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，帝因食糖追遇毒，庚子，大漸。

translations.literal: In the fourth month in summer the Emperor was poisoned while eating rice cakes; on the day gengzi his illness became critical.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month in summer the Emperor was poisoned while eating rice cakes; on gengzi his illness became critical.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：人生天地之間，稟五常之氣；

translations.literal: An edict said: Human life between Heaven and Earth receives the qi of the five constants;
translations.idiomatic: An edict said, "Human life between Heaven and Earth receives the qi of the five constants;

sentences.zh: 天地有窮已，五常有推移，人安得長在。

translations.literal: Heaven and Earth have their end, the five constants shift and change, and how can a man endure forever?
translations.idiomatic: Heaven and Earth have their end, the five constants shift and change, and how can a man endure forever?

sentences.zh: 是以有生有死者，物理之必然。

translations.literal: Therefore that there is birth and there is death is the necessary law of things.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore that there is birth and there is death is the necessary law of things.

sentences.zh: 處必然之理，修短之間，何足多恨。

translations.literal: Facing the law of necessity, what regret can there be in the span between long and short?
translations.idiomatic: Facing the law of necessity, what regret can there be in the span between long and short?

sentences.zh: 朕雖不德，性好典墳，披覽聖賢余論，未嘗不以此自曉。

translations.literal: Though I lack virtue, by nature I love the classics; reading the remaining writings of sages and worthies, I have never failed to understand myself thereby.
translations.idiomatic: Though I lack virtue, by nature I love the classics; reading the remaining writings of sages and worthies, I have never failed to understand myself thereby.

sentences.zh: 今乃命也，夫復何言！

translations.literal: Now it is fate; what more is there to say!
translations.idiomatic: Now it is fate; what more is there to say!

sentences.zh: 諸公及在朝卿大夫士、軍中大小督將軍人等，並立勛效，積有年載；

translations.literal: You lords and the ministers, grand masters, and scholars at court, and commanders and generals great and small in the army, have all established merit over many years;
translations.idiomatic: You lords and the ministers, grand masters, and scholars at court, and commanders and generals great and small in the army, have all established merit over many years;

sentences.zh: 輔翼太祖，成我周家，令朕纘承大業，處萬乘之上。

translations.literal: you aided Grand Ancestor and completed our house of Zhou, enabling me to inherit the great enterprise and stand above the imperial chariot.
translations.idiomatic: you aided Grand Ancestor and completed our house of Zhou, enabling me to inherit the great enterprise and stand above the imperial chariot.

sentences.zh: 此上不負太祖，下不負朕躬。

translations.literal: In this you have not failed Grand Ancestor above, nor failed me below.
translations.idiomatic: In this you have not failed Grand Ancestor above, nor failed me below.

sentences.zh: 朕得啟手啟足，從先帝於地下，實無恨於心矣。

translations.literal: That I may depart with clean hands and feet and follow the former emperors underground truly leaves no regret in my heart.
translations.idiomatic: That I may depart with clean hands and feet and follow the former emperors underground truly leaves no regret in my heart.

sentences.zh: 所可恨者，朕享大位，可謂四年矣，不能使政化修理，黎庶豐足；

translations.literal: What I regret is that though I have held the great throne for what may be called four years, I could not make government and teaching well ordered and the people rich and sufficient;
translations.idiomatic: What I regret is that though I have held the great throne for what may be called four years, I could not make government and teaching well ordered and the people rich and sufficient;

sentences.zh: 九州未一，二方猶梗，顧此恨恨，目用不瞑。

translations.literal: the nine provinces are not united, and two regions still block the way; thinking of this I am full of regret, and my eyes will not close in peace.
translations.idiomatic: the nine provinces are not united, and two regions still block the way; thinking of this I am full of regret, and my eyes will not close in peace.

sentences.zh: 唯冀仁兄冢宰，洎朕先正先父公卿大臣等，協和為心，勉力相勸，勿忘太祖遺誌，提挈後人。

translations.literal: I only hope that my elder brother the Grand Minister, together with my former upright ministers and former fathers the dukes and great ministers, will be of one mind in harmony and exert themselves to encourage one another, not forgetting Grand Ancestor's final charge and guiding those who come after.
translations.idiomatic: I only hope that my elder brother the Grand Minister, together with my former upright ministers and former fathers the dukes and great ministers, will be of one mind in harmony and exert themselves to encourage one another, not forgetting Grand Ancestor's final charge and guiding those who come after.

sentences.zh: 朕雖沒九泉，形骸不朽。

translations.literal: Though I sink into the nine springs, my purpose will not perish.
translations.idiomatic: Though I sink into the nine springs, my purpose will not perish.

sentences.zh: 今大位虛曠，社稷無主；

translations.literal: Now the great throne stands empty and the altars of state have no lord;
translations.idiomatic: Now the great throne stands empty and the altars of state have no lord;

sentences.zh: 朕兒幼少，未堪當國。

translations.literal: my sons are young and cannot yet bear the realm.
translations.idiomatic: my sons are young and cannot yet bear the realm.

sentences.zh: 魯國公邕，朕之介弟，寬仁大度，海內共聞，能弘我周家，必此子也。

translations.literal: Duke of Lu Yong is my younger brother by the same mother; broad, benevolent, and magnanimous, he is known throughout the realm; he alone can expand our house of Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: Duke of Lu Yong is my younger brother by the same mother; broad, benevolent, and magnanimous, he is known throughout the realm; he alone can expand our house of Zhou.

sentences.zh: 夫人貴有始終，公等事太祖，輔朕躬，可謂有始矣。

translations.literal: It is fitting that a man honor beginning and end; you served Grand Ancestor and aided me; that may be called a beginning.
translations.idiomatic: It is fitting that a man honor beginning and end; you served Grand Ancestor and aided me; that may be called a beginning.

sentences.zh: 若克念政道，顧其艱難，輔邕以主天下者，可謂有終矣。

translations.literal: If you keep government in mind and regard its difficulties, and aid Yong in ruling the realm, that may be called an end.
translations.idiomatic: If you keep government in mind and regard its difficulties, and aid Yong in ruling the realm, that may be called an end.

sentences.zh: 哀死事生，人臣大節，公等可思念此言，令萬代稱嘆。

translations.literal: To mourn the dead and serve the living is the great duty of a minister; you should keep these words in mind and let future ages praise them.
translations.idiomatic: To mourn the dead and serve the living is the great duty of a minister; you should keep these words in mind and let future ages praise them.

sentences.zh: 朕稟生儉素，非能力行菲薄。

translations.literal: I received life in frugality and simplicity; it is not that I could practice austerity by my own strength.
translations.idiomatic: I received life in frugality and simplicity; it is not that I could practice austerity by my own strength.

sentences.zh: 每寢大布之被，服大帛之衣，凡是器用，皆無雕刻。

translations.literal: Each night I slept under coarse hemp quilts and wore coarse silk robes; all utensils were without carving.
translations.idiomatic: Each night I slept under coarse hemp quilts and wore coarse silk robes; all utensils were without carving.

sentences.zh: 身終之日，豈容違棄此好。

translations.literal: On the day my life ends, how could I abandon this preference?
translations.idiomatic: On the day my life ends, how could I abandon this preference?

sentences.zh: 喪事所須，務從儉約，斂以時服，勿使有金玉之飾。

translations.literal: What the funeral requires must follow frugality; enshroud me in seasonal garments and do not allow gold or jade ornament.
translations.idiomatic: What the funeral requires must follow frugality; enshroud me in seasonal garments and do not allow gold or jade ornament.

sentences.zh: 若以禮不可闕，皆令用瓦。

translations.literal: If ritual cannot be omitted, let everything be of tile.
translations.idiomatic: If ritual cannot be omitted, let everything be of tile.

sentences.zh: 小斂訖，七日哭。

translations.literal: When the lesser encoffining is complete, mourn for seven days.
translations.idiomatic: When the lesser encoffining is complete, mourn for seven days.

sentences.zh: 文武百官，各權辟麻苴，以素服從事。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials shall each temporarily wear hemp mourning and serve in plain garments.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials shall each temporarily wear hemp mourning and serve in plain garments.

sentences.zh: 葬日，選擇不毛之地，因勢為墳，勿封勿樹。

translations.literal: On the burial day choose barren ground and make the mound according to the terrain; do not mound it high and do not plant trees.
translations.idiomatic: On the burial day choose barren ground and make the mound according to the terrain; do not mound it high and do not plant trees.

sentences.zh: 且厚葬傷生，聖人所誡。

translations.literal: Moreover, lavish burial harms the living; this the sages forbade.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, lavish burial harms the living; this the sages forbade.

sentences.zh: 既服膺聖人之教，安敢違之。

translations.literal: Having accepted the sages' teaching, how dare I violate it?
translations.idiomatic: Having accepted the sages' teaching, how dare I violate it?

sentences.zh: 凡百官司，勿異朕意。

translations.literal: All officials of every rank, do not depart from my intent.
translations.idiomatic: All officials of every rank, do not depart from my intent.

sentences.zh: 四方州鎮使到，各令三日哭。

translations.literal: When envoys from the four directions and regional commands arrive, each shall mourn for three days.
translations.idiomatic: When envoys from the four directions and regional commands arrive, each shall mourn for three days.

sentences.zh: 哭訖，權辟凶服，還以素服從事，待大例除。

translations.literal: When mourning ends, temporarily leave off mourning garments and return to plain garments for service, waiting for the general term of mourning to end.
translations.idiomatic: When mourning ends, temporarily leave off mourning garments and return to plain garments for service, waiting for the general term of mourning to end.

sentences.zh: 非有呼召，各按部自守，不得輒奔赴闕庭。

translations.literal: Unless summoned, each shall guard his post and not rashly hurry to the court.
translations.idiomatic: Unless summoned, each shall guard his post and not rashly hurry to the court.

sentences.zh: 禮有通塞隨時之義，葬訖，內外悉除服從吉。

translations.literal: Ritual has the meaning of adapting to the time; when burial is complete, within and without all shall leave mourning and return to auspicious dress.
translations.idiomatic: Ritual has the meaning of adapting to the time; when burial is complete, within and without all shall leave mourning and return to auspicious dress.

sentences.zh: 三年之內，勿禁婚娶，一令如平常也。

translations.literal: Within three years do not forbid marriage; let everything be as in normal times.
translations.idiomatic: Within three years do not forbid marriage; let everything be as in normal times.

sentences.zh: 時事殷猥，病困心亂，止能及此。

translations.literal: Affairs are pressing and numerous; sick and troubled in mind, I can reach only this far.
translations.idiomatic: Affairs are pressing and numerous; sick and troubled in mind, I can reach only this far.

sentences.zh: 如事有不盡，準此以類為斷。

translations.literal: If matters are not fully covered, decide similar cases by this standard.
translations.idiomatic: If matters are not fully covered, decide similar cases by this standard.

sentences.zh: 死而可忍，古人有之，朕今忍死，盡此懷抱。

translations.literal: That death can be borne, the ancients knew; I now bear death to exhaust this heartfelt intent.
translations.idiomatic: That death can be borne, the ancients knew; I now bear death to exhaust this heartfelt intent.

sentences.zh: 其詔即帝口授也。

translations.literal: The edict was dictated from the Emperor's own mouth.
translations.idiomatic: The edict was dictated from the Emperor's own mouth.

sentences.zh: 辛丑，帝崩於延壽殿，時年二十七。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou the Emperor died at Yanshou Hall; he was twenty-seven years old.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou the Emperor died at Yanshou Hall; he was twenty-seven.

sentences.zh: 謚曰明皇帝，廟號世宗。

translations.literal: His posthumous title was Emperor Ming; his temple name was Shizong.
translations.idiomatic: His posthumous title was Emperor Ming; his temple name was Shizong.

sentences.zh: 五月辛未，葬於昭陵。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei of the fifth month he was buried at Zhaoling.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei of the fifth month he was buried at Zhaoling.

sentences.zh: 帝寬明仁厚，敦睦九族，有君人之量。

translations.literal: The Emperor was broad, clear, benevolent, and generous; he treated the nine clans with affection and had the measure of a ruler.
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor was broad, clear, benevolent, and generous; he treated the nine clans with affection and had the measure of a ruler.

sentences.zh: 幼而好學，博覽群書。

translations.literal: From youth he loved learning and read widely among the books.
translations.idiomatic: From youth he loved learning and read widely among the books.

sentences.zh: 善屬文，詞彩溫麗。

translations.literal: He was skilled at literary composition; his language was warm and elegant.
translations.idiomatic: He was skilled at literary composition; his language was warm and elegant.

sentences.zh: 及即位，集公卿已下有文學者八十餘人，於麟趾殿刊校經史。

translations.literal: When he ascended the throne, he gathered more than eighty men of letters among the dukes, ministers, and those below, and at Linqi Hall collated and edited the classics and histories.
translations.idiomatic: When he ascended the throne, he gathered more than eighty men of letters among the dukes, ministers, and those below, and at Linqi Hall collated and edited the classics and histories.

sentences.zh: 又捃采眾書，自義、農已來，訖於魏末，敘為《世譜》凡百卷。

translations.literal: He also gathered books from many sources, from Shennong down to the end of Wei, and arranged them into Genealogies of the Age in one hundred scrolls.
translations.idiomatic: He also gathered books from many sources, from Shennong down to the end of Wei, and arranged them into Genealogies of the Age in one hundred scrolls.

sentences.zh: 所著文章十卷。

translations.literal: His own writings filled ten scrolls.
translations.idiomatic: His own writings filled ten scrolls.

sentences.zh: 論曰：昔者水運將終，群凶放命。

translations.literal: The commentary says: In former times the water mandate was nearing its end, and many villains cast off restraint.
translations.idiomatic: The commentary says: In former times the water mandate was nearing its end, and many villains cast off restraint.

sentences.zh: 或權威震主，或釁逆滔天。

translations.literal: Some made their authority shake the ruler; some raised rebellion that overflowed heaven.
translations.idiomatic: Some made their authority shake the ruler; some raised rebellion that overflowed heaven.

sentences.zh: 咸謂大寶可以力致，神器可以求得，而卒誅夷繼及，亡不旋踵。

translations.literal: All thought the great treasure could be attained by force and the sacred regalia obtained by seeking; yet in the end execution and extermination followed one upon another, and none survived a turning of the heel.
translations.idiomatic: All thought the great treasure could be attained by force and the sacred regalia obtained by seeking; yet in the end execution and extermination followed one upon another, and none survived a turning of the heel.

sentences.zh: 是知天命有底，庸可慆乎。

translations.literal: From this one knows that Heaven's mandate has its foundation; how could it be presumed upon?
translations.idiomatic: From this one knows that Heaven's mandate has its foundation; how could it be presumed upon?

sentences.zh: 周文爰自潛躍，眾無一旋，驅馳戎馬之際，躡足行伍之間。

translations.literal: Duke Wen of Zhou rose from hidden advancement when none stood with him; he drove through the intervals of war and trod among the ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Duke Wen of Zhou rose from hidden advancement when none stood with him; he drove through the intervals of war and trod among the ranks.

sentences.zh: 時屬與能，運膺啟聖，鳩集義勇，糾合同盟。

translations.literal: The time called for able men; fortune received the opening of sage rule; he gathered righteous courage and rallied allied forces.
translations.idiomatic: The time called for able men; fortune received the opening of sage rule; he gathered righteous courage and rallied allied forces.

sentences.zh: 一舉而殄仇讎，再駕而匡帝室。

translations.literal: One stroke extinguished the enemy; a second journey restored the imperial house.
translations.idiomatic: One stroke extinguished the enemy; a second journey restored the imperial house.

sentences.zh: 於是內詢帷幄，外杖材雄；

translations.literal: Within he consulted the tent; without he relied on heroic talent;
translations.idiomatic: Within he consulted the tent; without he relied on heroic talent;

sentences.zh: 推至誠以待人，弘大順以訓物。

translations.literal: he extended utmost sincerity in treating men and spread the great accord to instruct the people.
translations.idiomatic: he extended utmost sincerity in treating men and spread the great accord to instruct the people.

sentences.zh: 高氏藉甲兵之眾，恃戎馬之強，屢入近畿，誌圖吞噬。

translations.literal: The Gao clan relied on the multitude of armored troops and the strength of war horses, repeatedly entering the near capital with intent to swallow and devour.
translations.idiomatic: The Gao clan relied on the multitude of armored troops and the strength of war horses, repeatedly entering the near capital with intent to swallow and devour.

sentences.zh: 及英謀電發，神旆風馳。

translations.literal: When heroic plans flashed like lightning, divine banners raced like the wind.
translations.idiomatic: When heroic plans flashed like lightning, divine banners raced like the wind.

sentences.zh: 弘農建城濮之勛，沙苑有昆陽之捷；

translations.literal: At Hongnong he built the merit of Chengpu; at Shawei he won the victory of Kunyang;
translations.idiomatic: At Hongnong he built the merit of Chengpu; at Shawei he won the victory of Kunyang;

sentences.zh: 取威定霸，以弱為強。

translations.literal: taking prestige to fix hegemony, he turned weakness into strength.
translations.idiomatic: taking prestige to fix hegemony, he turned weakness into strength.

sentences.zh: 紹元宗之衰緒，創隆周之景命。

translations.literal: He continued the declining line of the primal ancestor and founded the bright mandate of ascending Zhou.
translations.idiomatic: He continued the declining line of the primal ancestor and founded the bright mandate of ascending Zhou.

sentences.zh: 南清江、漢，西舉巴、蜀，北控沙漠，東據伊、瀍。

translations.literal: South he cleared the Yangtze and Han; west he raised Ba and Shu; north he controlled the desert; east he held Yi and the Chan.
translations.idiomatic: South he cleared the Yangtze and Han; west he raised Ba and Shu; north he controlled the desert; east he held Yi and the Chan.

sentences.zh: 乃擯落魏、晉，憲章古昔；

translations.literal: He cast aside Wei and Jin and took the statutes of antiquity as his model;
translations.idiomatic: He cast aside Wei and Jin and took the statutes of antiquity as his model;

sentences.zh: 修六官之廢典，成一代之鴻規。

translations.literal: he restored the abandoned canon of the Six Offices and completed the great design of an age.
translations.idiomatic: he restored the abandoned canon of the Six Offices and completed the great design of an age.

sentences.zh: 德刑並用，勛賢兼敘。

translations.literal: Virtue and punishment were used together; merit and worth were both honored.
translations.idiomatic: Virtue and punishment were used together; merit and worth were both honored.

sentences.zh: 遠安邇悅，俗阜人和。

translations.literal: The distant were pacified and the near rejoiced; custom flourished and men were in harmony.
translations.idiomatic: The distant were pacified and the near rejoiced; custom flourished and men were in harmony.

sentences.zh: 億兆之望有歸，揖讓之期允集。

translations.literal: The hope of the hundred million had its return; the time of abdication and acceptance was truly gathered.
translations.idiomatic: The hope of the hundred million had its return; the time of abdication and acceptance was truly gathered.

sentences.zh: 功業若此，人臣以終，盛矣哉。

translations.literal: Merit and enterprise such as this, for a minister to finish, how magnificent!
translations.idiomatic: Merit and enterprise such as this, for a minister to finish, how magnificent!

sentences.zh: 非求雄略冠時，英姿不世；

translations.literal: If one did not seek heroic strategy that crowned the age and bearing unmatched in a generation;
translations.idiomatic: If one did not seek heroic strategy that crowned the age and bearing unmatched in a generation;

sentences.zh: 天與神授，緯武經文者，孰能與於此乎。

translations.literal: heaven-given and spirit-conferred, weaving martial and civil together, who could equal this?
translations.idiomatic: heaven-given and spirit-conferred, weaving martial and civil together, who could equal this?

sentences.zh: 昔漢獻蒙塵，曹公成夾輔之業；

translations.literal: Formerly Emperor Xian of Han suffered dust on the road, and Duke Cao completed the enterprise of supporting the throne;
translations.idiomatic: Formerly Emperor Xian of Han suffered dust on the road, and Duke Cao completed the enterprise of supporting the throne;

sentences.zh: 晉安播蕩，宋武建匡合之勛。

translations.literal: Emperor An of Jin was driven into turmoil, and Emperor Wu of Song built the merit of restoring unity.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor An of Jin was driven into turmoil, and Emperor Wu of Song built the merit of restoring unity.

sentences.zh: 校德論功，綽有餘裕。

translations.literal: Comparing virtue and weighing merit, he had abundance to spare.
translations.idiomatic: Comparing virtue and weighing merit, he had abundance to spare.

sentences.zh: 至於渚宮制勝，闔城孥戮；

translations.literal: As for victory at Zhugong and slaughtering the families of the whole city;
translations.idiomatic: As for victory at Zhugong and slaughtering the families of the whole city;

sentences.zh: 蠕蠕歸命，盡種誅夷。

translations.literal: the Rouran submitting and exterminating the whole tribe;
translations.idiomatic: the Rouran submitting and exterminating the whole tribe;

sentences.zh: 雖事出於權道，而用乖於德教，斯為過矣。

translations.literal: though the acts arose from expedient policy, the means departed from the teaching of virtue; this was excessive.
translations.idiomatic: though the acts arose from expedient policy, the means departed from the teaching of virtue; this was excessive.

sentences.zh: 孝閔承既安之業，膺樂推之運；

translations.literal: Xiaomin inherited an already settled enterprise and received fortune pushed upon him;
translations.idiomatic: Xiaomin inherited an already settled enterprise and received fortune pushed upon him;

sentences.zh: 明皇處代邸之尊，纂大宗之緒。

translations.literal: Emperor Ming occupied the honor of the substitute fief and continued the line of the great ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Ming occupied the honor of the substitute fief and continued the line of the great ancestor.

sentences.zh: 始則權臣專命，終乃政出私門；

translations.literal: At first powerful ministers held sole command; in the end government issued from private gates;
translations.idiomatic: At first powerful ministers held sole command; in the end government issued from private gates;

sentences.zh: 俱懷芒刺之疑，用致幽弒之禍，惜哉。

translations.literal: both harbored the suspicion of a thorn in the flesh and thereby met the calamity of secret assassination; pitiable indeed.
translations.idiomatic: both harbored the suspicion of a thorn in the flesh and thereby met the calamity of secret assassination; pitiable indeed.
